Model predictions across many sub-models for parsnip fits

Source: R/parsnip.R
multi_predict_rule_ensemble_parsnip.Rd

These methods are used when a RuleFit model is fit with parsnip::rule_fit() and the "rule_ensemble" engine. They produce predictions for multiple values of penalty without refitting.

Usage

# S3 method for class '`_rule_ensemble_xgb`'
multi_predict(object, new_data, type = NULL, penalty = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class '`_rule_ensemble_lgb`'
multi_predict(object, new_data, type = NULL, penalty = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class '`_rule_ensemble_ctb`'
multi_predict(object, new_data, type = NULL, penalty = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

A model_fit object from the "rule_ensemble" engine.

new_data

A data frame of predictors.

type

A single character value or NULL. Possible values are "numeric", "class", "prob", or "raw". When NULL, "numeric" is used for regression and "class" for classification.

penalty

A numeric vector of penalty values. When NULL, the penalty value used to fit the model is used.

...

Not currently used.

Value

A tibble with the same number of rows as new_data and a list column .pred.
